study: On the desk's own round trips, does requiring the %R double-check (sell yes) as well as a ratchet-shelf hit improve the exit versus selling at the first shelf hit?
origin: Operator: keep good names running. Current exit is the stop. Proposed exit sells only when the working ratchet shelf is hit AND tools/sell_double_check.py says sell yes (both %R lines off their 10-minute lookback high, live price included). No lookback or no live price stays sell yes, so a blind shelf still sells. Up, flat, or only one line down does not sell.
universe: Every ai_reports/outcomes.jsonl round trip whose entry is 09:30-15:50 ET, entry_price > 0, plan stop is 0.5% to 20% under the fill (the recorded stop_price is that plan stop, median about 5%; it is not the working shelf), and whose (symbol, ET day) is in ai_reports/runway_bars_cache.pkl. One row per outcome. RTH minute bars only.
shelf: ai_positions.initial_local_stop then local_profit_stop once per completed minute, live config (give_r 0.12, peak leash 0.35%, decay idle 8s). The shelf is the value from prior minutes. This bar's low hits it. A gap through fills at the open; otherwise at the shelf. Decay steps once per minute, not every 8s. Both arms share this shelf until the first declined hit.

arms.stop: Sell at the first shelf hit. Still open at 15:50 ET flattens at that bar's close.
arms.stop_and_check: Same shelf. A hit sells only when the double-check on closed minutes plus the touch price as the live reading says sell yes. A sell-no hit is declined and the shelf keeps ratcheting. 15:50 still flattens.

cost: Gross bp per trade, (exit/entry - 1) * 1e4. Both arms pay one round trip, so a spread cancels in the difference and is not fetched. The reported edge is the paired difference, not a claim of positive absolute net.
statistic: Per scored day (>= 5 trades): mean of (stop_and_check bp - stop bp). day_stat from tools/studies/std_scorer.py across those days (Newey-West lag 5).
pass: PASS only if the shelf actually binds (the stop arm exits on a shelf hit for at least 30% of trades), the daily paired mean is >= +3 bp/trade, t >= 2, and at least 60% of scored days are positive, with at least 8 scored days. Anything else is FAIL and the live exit does not change. A pass is a replay result, not the G-LIVE bar, and does not by itself switch the desk.
no_retuning: Lookback 10, direction eps 0.05, fast 21/7, slow 112/3, and the pass bar are fixed. A $10+ slice may be printed and cannot flip the verdict.
caveats: Minute bars, not the live 2-second chase. The 8-second decay steps once a minute.
runway_bars_cache.pkl is RTH only, so the slow line is unwarmed early and those hits default to sell yes.
The cache does not include sessions after it was built. Later days are absent, not zero.
Touch price is the live %R input, so a wick is judged at the shelf, not at the bar close.
